companies.name: Tractable
companies.description: AI for accident and disaster recovery.
companies.funding_notes: Tractable (tractable.ai), London computer-vision AI for car/property damage appraisal. Raised ~$179.9M equity across Seed to Series E; leads Zetta, Ignition, Insight, Georgian, SoftBank Vision Fund 2; valued at $1B at the 2021 Series D. Series B also included ~$5M of secondary not counted in the total.

companies.name: Cleo
companies.description: AI-powered assistant for personal finances.
companies.funding_notes: Cleo (meetcleo.com), London/US AI personal-finance assistant. ~$139M equity raised: $15M through the 2018 Balderton-led Series A (company figure, incl. LocalGlobe-led £2M seed), $44M Series B (EQT Ventures, 2020) and $80M Series C (Sofina, 2022). Caveat: Sifted (Jul 2025) reported a previously undisclosed raise from existing investors in its 2024 accounts (~$38.8M of convertible loan notes per secondary summaries), not counted here.

companies.name: PolyAI
companies.description: Customer-led voice assistants for enterprises.
companies.funding_notes: PolyAI (poly.ai), London enterprise voice-AI for customer service, Cambridge Dialog Systems Group spinout. Raised ~$204M equity (company says >$200M total) from Seed to an $86M Series D (Dec 2025) co-led by Georgian, Hedosophia and Khosla; earlier leads Amadeus/Passion, Point72, Khosla, Georgian. Seed date not published; Sept 2021 $14M Khosla round's stage was not labelled; Series C lead not named (new investors Hedosophia, NVentures, Zendesk).

companies.name: Aztec
companies.description: Privacy layer for web3.
companies.funding_notes: Aztec (aztec.network, formerly Aztec Protocol), London Ethereum privacy/ZK-rollup L2 (inventors of PLONK). ~$119.1M equity raised: $2.1M seed (ConsenSys Labs, 2018), $17M Series A (Paradigm, 2021), $100M Series B (a16z crypto, 2022). Separately, a public AZTEC token sale in Dec 2025 raised ~19,476 ETH (~$61M), not counted as equity.

companies.name: Accurx
companies.description: Powering communications in the healthcare sector.
companies.funding_notes: Accurx (accurx.com), London healthcare communications platform used by most GP practices in England. ~£36.3M equity across a £8.8M Series A (Atomico, Feb 2019) and £27.5M Series B (Lakestar, Sept 2021; first announced at £25M). Pre-Series A angel/EF money (e.g., Tom Tugendhat per Companies House, per TechCrunch) is not quantified; an unverified ~£5M 2024 investment reported only by low-quality aggregators is not included.

companies.name: Nivoda
companies.description: The world’s fastest-growing online jewelry marketplace.
companies.funding_notes: Nivoda (nivoda.com), London/NY B2B marketplace for diamonds, gemstones and jewellery. ~$41M disclosed equity: $11M Series A led by Headline (announced May 2023; company LinkedIn posts suggest it was being raised from 2022) and $30M primary Series B led by Avenir Growth Capital (May 2024). Earlier seed allotments (Oct 2020 per Companies House filings) have no public amount from an allowed source.

companies.name: Spore.Bio
companies.description: Building a new generation of microbiological technologies.
companies.funding_notes: Spore.Bio (spore.bio), Paris AI/biophotonics rapid microbiology testing. ~$31.3M raised: €8M pre-seed led by LocalGlobe (Dec 2023, ~$8.3M per TechCrunch) and $23M (EU-Startups: €22M) Series A led by Singular (Feb 2025). Total mixes EUR/USD using TechCrunch's conversion.

companies.name: Sonantic
companies.description: Hyper-realistic AI voices for the entertainment industry.
companies.funding_notes: Sonantic (sonantic.io, formerly Speak Ai), London AI voice-acting startup. Raised a €2.3M seed led by EQT Ventures (Mar 2020); TechCrunch said total funding was under $3M, incl. earlier EF/AME Cloud/Horizons/angel money of undisclosed size. Acquired by Spotify in June 2022 (undisclosed terms).

companies.name: Permutive
companies.description: Rebuilding data in advertising to protect privacy.
companies.funding_notes: Permutive (permutive.com), London/NY privacy-first publisher data/ad platform. $105M total raised per Tech.eu at the $75M Series C (SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Nov 2021); $18.5M Series B led by Octopus Ventures (Jul 2020). Earlier seed/Series A (~$11.5M combined; aggregators cite a ~$10M Series A in Jan 2018 with Octopus/EQT) lack an allowed primary source, so not itemised; no later rounds found.

companies.name: Ochre Bio
companies.description: Genomic medicine for transplanted livers.
companies.funding_notes: Ochre Bio (ochre-bio.com), Oxford/London RNA therapies for transplant and chronic liver disease (also a YC alum). $39.6M equity: $9.6M seed led by Khosla Ventures (Jun 2021) and $30M Series A (Oct 2022; no lead named, Khosla participated). Separately signed a Boehringer Ingelheim collaboration (Apr 2024; up to $35M upfront/near-term, >$1B potential), which is non-dilutive and not counted; EIT Health headline says €30M vs $30M elsewhere.

companies.name: Open Cosmos
companies.description: Designing, manufacturing, and operating satellites.
companies.funding_notes: Open Cosmos (open-cosmos.com), UK/Spain satellite manufacturer and data/connectivity operator. ~$405M equity (≈$7M pre-2023, $50M 2023 round co-led by ETF Partners/Trill Impact/A&G, and €300M (~$348M) Sept 2026 round led by Lightrock (with ETF Partners), reported as a Series C at a >$1B valuation). Caveats: the company release doesn't name a stage; ICF's €31M (late 2025/May 2026 reports) is probably part of the €300M round and isn't counted separately; a €4M Avançsa loan is debt; ESA/UKSA mission contracts aren't treated as grants.

companies.name: Gensyn
companies.description: Making compute for AI as accessible as oxygen for humans.
companies.funding_notes: Gensyn (gensyn.ai), London decentralized machine-learning compute protocol. ~$50.6M equity: $1.1M pre-seed (2021), $6.5M seed led by Eden Block (Mar 2022), $43M Series A led by a16z crypto (Jun 2023). Separately, a Dec 2025 public $AI token sale on Sonar reportedly raised ~$16.1M (crypto-press figures), not counted as equity.

companies.name: Opply
companies.description: Ingredient marketplace for small consumer goods brands.

investors: angels from GoCardless, Trouva, Farewill, Jamjar

companies.funding_notes: Opply (opply.com), London AI-driven B2B ingredient sourcing/supply-chain marketplace for SME food & drink brands, founded 2021 by Helen Murphy. Only disclosed round is a $4M (~£3.3M) seed co-led by Chalfen Ventures and Anthemis (Jun 2022); no later rounds found.
notable_investors: angels from GoCardless, Trouva, Farewill, Jamjar

companies.name: Neptune Robotics
companies.description: Robotic cleaning for the shipping industry.
companies.funding_notes: Neptune Robotics (neptune-robotics.com), Hong Kong-founded (now Singapore HQ) robotic ship-hull cleaning. ~$69.25M disclosed equity: $17.25M Series A led by Sequoia China (Apr 2022) and $52M Series B led by Granite Asia with NYK (Sep 2025). Also backed earlier by SOSV/HAX (accelerator money not counted); Bloomberg reported a possible US IPO as early as 2027.

companies.name: Qantev
companies.description: AI claims platform for health and life insurance.
companies.funding_notes: Qantev (qantev.com), Paris AI health/life-insurance claims platform (clients incl. AXA, Generali). ~€41.7M equity (company: 'over €40M'): seed led by Elaia (Nov 2020), €10M Series A co-led by Omnes and RAISE Ventures (Oct 2022), €30M Series B led by Blossom Capital (Oct 2024). Caveat: the seed is reported as $1.7M by Tech.eu but €1.7M by TechCrunch; recorded as EUR.

companies.name: Credit Kudos
companies.description: Helping credit providers make better decisions using better data.
companies.funding_notes: Credit Kudos (creditkudos.com), London open-banking challenger credit bureau. ~£7.8M equity: £600K seed (NFT Ventures, 2016), £2.2M unlabelled round (Fair by Design, Apr 2019), £5M Series A (AlbionVC, Apr 2020). Acquired by Apple in March 2022 for a reported ~$150M (CNBC, unnamed source); later renamed Apple Payments Services.

companies.name: Omnea
companies.description: Effortless procurement automation.
companies.funding_notes: Omnea (omnea.co), London AI procurement orchestration platform founded 2022 by ex-Tessian execs Ben Freeman and Ben Allen. Raised ~$75M total equity: $5M seed (co-led by First Round & Point Nine, undated, first disclosed Oct 2024), $20M Series A led by Accel (Oct 2024), $50M Series B co-led by Insight Partners and Khosla Ventures (Sep 2025); company says total 'over $75M'.

companies.name: Intropic
companies.description: Providing data refineries for investment management firms.
companies.funding_notes: Intropic (intropic.io; Intropic Limited, Companies House 11656145), London data/financial-intelligence provider to hedge funds, founded 2018 by Ravinder Bhadhal and Sam Shannon. Seed-funded by Connect Ventures in 2019 and Series A with Octopus Ventures (Feb 2022). Caveat: round sizes (£3m Aug 2019, £18.6m Feb 2022, ~£21.6m total) come from Companies House share-allotment data aggregated by Sonde/Nordic9, not a company press release; leads not publicly stated.

companies.name: Scarlet
companies.description: Hastening the transition to universally accessible healthcare.
companies.funding_notes: Scarlet (scarlet.cc), London-based UK/EU notified body certifying software and AI medical devices, founded by James Dewar and Jamie Cox (ex-Babylon Health). Raised ~£6M (~$7M) seed led by Creandum with Kindred (Aug 2022) and a $17.5M Series A led by Atomico (2024; Fortune reported it Sep 2024, aggregators date it Jun 2024), ~$24.5M total equity. Caveat: seed amount from Nordic9 (£6M ≈ $6.96M); total is an approximate USD conversion.

companies.name: Genomines
companies.description: Efficient plant-based mining.

grants.name: Bpifrance i-Demo (France 2030) and Aide au Développement Deeptech (ADD) plus other non-dilutive funding (aggregate)

companies.funding_notes: Genomines (genomines.com), Paris phytomining startup farming nickel with genetically enhanced hyperaccumulator plants, founded 2021. $5M seed (Oct 2021, Lowercarbon/EF) and $45M Series A co-led by Engine Ventures and Forbion BioEconomy (Sep 2025); Forbion states only $37M of the $45M was equity (rest grant/debt), so equity total ≈ $42M; company cites $62M total capital incl. ~$12M non-dilutive (Bpifrance i-Demo/ADD). Caveat: seed reported as $5M or $5.2M.

companies.name: Green Li-ion
companies.description: World-first deep-clean technology to fully rejuvenate lithium-ion batteries.
companies.funding_notes: Green Li-ion (greenli-ion.com), Singapore lithium-ion battery recycling tech company (also a HAX/SOSV portfolio company). Disclosed equity ≈ $39.6M: $3.45M seed led by LiNiCo (2021), $11.55M Series A led by Energy Revolution Ventures (Apr 2022), $20.5M pre-Series B led by TRIREC (Mar 2023, $187M post-money), $4.1M from PETRONAS' Twin Towers Ventures (Sep 2023), plus an undisclosed bridge led by Laurence Escalante (May 2025). Planned full Series B not publicly closed.

companies.name: CloudNC
companies.description: Reinventing precision manufacturing.

grants.name: Innovate UK – CloudNC Proof of Concept
Innovate UK – Automated Post-Processing Platform for Metals Additive Manufacturing (CloudNC share)
UKRI/Innovate UK – Autonomous Robust & Rapid Processes for Machining of Aerospace Parts (CloudNC share)

companies.funding_notes: CloudNC (cloudnc.com), London/Chelmsford AI CAM software (CAM Assist) company founded 2015 by Theo Saville and Chris Emery at EF. Rounds: seed led by Episode 1 (2016, aggregators report ~£2M; amount not confirmed by primary source), £9M Series A led by Atomico (2018), $45M Series B led by Autodesk (2022), $20M Series B extension led by Nimble Ventures (Sep 2026). TechCrunch reports $128M lifetime raised (used here); disclosed equity rounds sum only ~$79M, so the lifetime figure likely includes undisclosed rounds and/or ~£3.9M UKRI grants.

companies.name: Mimica
companies.description: Building the future of work automation.

grants.name: Innovate UK – Automated RPA
Innovate UK – Automated RPA COVID Continuity
Innovate UK – Data Anonymisation for Automation Discovery in Professional and Financial Services

companies.funding_notes: Mimica (mimica.ai; Mimica Automation Ltd), London/NY process-intelligence/task-mining company founded 2017 by Tuhin Chakraborty and Raphael Holca-Lamarre. Disclosed equity ≈ $32.2M: undisclosed seed (EF, Episode 1), $6M (£4.4M) Series A led by Khosla Ventures (Nov 2021), $26.2M Series B led by Paladin Capital Group (Sep 2025); plus ~£670K Innovate UK grants. Note: unrelated 'Mimica Lab Ltd' (food-expiry labels) also has UKRI grants—not included.

companies.name: Unitary
companies.description: Redefining how companies run operations.

grants.name: Innovate UK – Shear: video understanding to automate content moderation (Unitary share)
Innovate UK – Spinor: algorithms to identify abuse in online text

companies.funding_notes: Unitary (unitary.ai), London company founded 2019 at EF by Sasha Haco and James Thewlis; began in AI video content moderation and has since pivoted to 'Virtual Agents' automating operations work (matches EF description). Raised ≈ $24.7M equity: £1.35M seed led by GFC (2020), $8M led by Plural (Mar 2023; Plural's Ian Hogarth described it as a $10M seed), $15M Series A led by Creandum (Oct 2023). Total uses ~$1.7M for the £1.35M round.

companies.name: Automata
companies.description: Lab automation robots for life-science workflows.

grants.name: Innovate UK – Eva: low-cost lightweight tabletop robotic arm

companies.funding_notes: Automata (automata.tech; Automata Technologies Ltd), London lab-automation company (LINQ) founded 2015 by Mostafa ElSayed and Suryansh Chandra, originally maker of the Eva desktop robot arm. ≈ $144.5M equity: ~$2.1M pre-Series A (implied by $9.5M total at Series A; details undisclosed), $7.4M Series A led by Hummingbird (2019), $50M Series B led by Octopus Ventures (2022), $40M unnamed round led by Dimension (Oct 2023), $45M Series C led by Dimension with Danaher Ventures (Jan 2026).

companies.name: Hadean
companies.description: Bridging physical and virtual worlds to enable defence forces, government agencies and businesses to plan, train and make faster, better decisions.

grants.name: Innovate UK – Hadean Massively Distributed Simulation Engine

companies.funding_notes: Hadean (hadean.com; Hadean Supercomputing Ltd), London distributed-computing/simulation company (now focused on defence & government training/decision-making digital twins), founded 2015 by Rashid Mansoor, Alec Mocatta et al. ≈ $47M equity: $2.6M seed led by White Cloud Capital (2017), £7.2M led by Draper Esprit (2019), $30M Series A led by Molten Ventures with Epic Games (Sep 2022), +$5M extension incl. Ericsson Ventures (Mar 2023). Total uses ~$9.4M for the £7.2M round; 2023 extension labelled by inference from company's wording ('complements' Series A).

companies.name: Phagos
companies.description: Bacteriophage therapies for antibiotic-resistant infections.

grants.name: Bpifrance i-Lab innovation competition Grand Prix

companies.funding_notes: Phagos (phagos.com), Paris phage-therapy company (veterinary/animal health first, human health later) founded 2021 by Alexandros Pantalis and Adèle James. €27.4M equity: €2.4M seed co-led by Demeter and Hoxton Ventures (Sep 2022) and €25M Series A co-led by CapAgro, Hoxton, CapHorn and Demeter (Oct 2025); plus €500K Bpifrance i-Lab prize (2022). An additional ~€1.4M Bpifrance grant (Aug 2023) appears only in aggregator data and is not included.

companies.name: nPlan
companies.description: AI forecasting for construction projects.

grants.name: Innovate UK – AI-Optimised Pathways for Schedule Execution (nPlan share)
Innovate UK – PLASMA digital planning & supply chain toolbox (nPlan share)
Innovate UK – AI for managing risk and execution contracts (nPlan share)
Innovate UK – Project 105877 Continuity Grant
Innovate UK – Data & AI for construction project slow-downs and restarts

companies.funding_notes: nPlan (nplan.io), London AI schedule-risk forecasting for construction/capital projects, founded 2017 by Dev Amratia and Alan Mosca at EF. ≈ $38.3M equity: £2.7M seed (Jun 2018), $18.5M (£13.43M) Series A led by GV (Mar 2021; company said $22.3M raised to date), $16M Series B led by CapHorn with Chevron Technology Ventures and Suffolk Technologies (Oct 2025). Also ~£900K Innovate UK grants. Seed investors listed are those reported in the Series A release, not confirmed as seed participants individually.

companies.name: Limbic
companies.description: Clinical AI to scale mental healthcare.

grants.name: Innovate UK – Using deep learning to predict clinical outcomes for mental health patients (Limbic share)
Innovate UK – Mobile app for psychological therapy support during COVID-19
Innovate UK – Deep learning clinical outcomes continuity grant

companies.funding_notes: Limbic (limbic.ai; Limbic Limited), London clinical mental-health AI (Limbic Access/Care used in NHS Talking Therapies), founded by Ross Harper and Sebastiaan de Vries. Only disclosed priced round is a $14M Series A led by Khosla Ventures (Mar 2024); 2019 seed (7percent Ventures, Social Starts, others) amount undisclosed; ~£518K Innovate UK grants. Caveats: a 'Gaingels Limbic AI 2026 LLC' SEC Form D (≈$240K, Mar 2026) hints at an unannounced follow-on; an aggregator-cited '$5.4M seed led by Anthemis' actually belongs to Poppins Health and was excluded.

companies.name: Finni Health
companies.description: Nationwide virtual ABA therapy for autism.
companies.funding_notes: Finni Health (finnihealth.com), ABA/autism-care platform enabling independent ABA practices, co-founded by Bukhtar Khan and Yilun Chen (EF; YC W23). Raised a $3.2M seed led by General Catalyst (Jun 2023). Caveats: aggregators (Dealroom/VCBacked) list an undisclosed 'Series A' in Mar 2024 with General Catalyst, Forum Ventures et al., but no company announcement found, so it is excluded; company operates in the US (SF/Delaware) despite EF listing Toronto.

companies.name: Pactio Technologies
companies.description: AI-native finance workflows in Microsoft Office.
companies.funding_notes: Pactio (pactio.io; Pactio Holding Inc.), London private-markets/finance workflow software (AI in Excel/Word/Outlook) founded 2021 by Eric Heimark and Lorenzo Foglianti. $14M (€12.9M/£11M) Series A led by EQT Ventures (Apr 2024; SEC Form D shows $13.79M sold) plus an early round with angels (Blomfield, Robinson, Delingpole et al.). Caveat: early-round size conflicts ($4.5M vs ~$2.3M in aggregators); SEC Form D (Jan 2022) shows $4.5M offered, $2.35M sold at filing — $2.35M used; round type 'seed' per aggregators, not company-stated. ≈$16.35M total.

companies.name: Genie AI
companies.description: AI legal assistant to draft, edit and review any agreement in minutes

grants.name: UKRI/Innovate UK – Anonymized data protocol and explainable models for AI adoption (Genie share; reported as £800K grant in 2019)
Innovate UK – continuity grant for project 104814
Innovate UK – Explaining legal contracts to SMEs via conversational AI

companies.funding_notes: Genie AI (genieai.co), London AI legal drafting/review assistant founded by Rafie Faruq and Nitish Mutha at EF. £1.2M seed led by Connect Ventures (Jul 2019, alongside an ~£800K UKRI grant) and $17.8M (£13.3M) Series A led by GV with Khosla (Oct 2024). Company says >$20M (£15M) total funding including grants; equity total ≈ $19.3M (seed converted ~$1.5M).

companies.name: VFlowTech
companies.description: Vanadium flow batteries for grid storage.

grants.name: Energy Market Authority (EMA) Singapore grant with Advario to scale Jurong Island VRFB pilot (1.5MWh to 40MWh)

companies.funding_notes: vflowtech.com (Singapore vanadium redox flow batteries). Roughly US$34.3M equity raised: ~US$0.8M seed (Temasek Foundation/Enterprise Singapore), US$3M pre-Series A led by Wavemaker (Oct 2021), US$10M Series A led by Real Tech Holdings (Feb 2023) and US$20.5M led by Granite Asia (May 2025, round stage not named). Seed amount approximate (SBR: 'more than S$1m (US$800k)') and some seed money may be foundation/agency support; EMA grant amount not disclosed.

companies.name: Atomionics
companies.description: Quantum gravimetry for resource mapping.
companies.funding_notes: atomionics.com (Singapore quantum gravimetry sensors 'Gravio' for mineral exploration). Disclosed equity ~US$14.6M: S$2.5M (~US$1.86M) seed led by Wavemaker with SGInnovate/Cap Vista (Apr 2021) and US$12.7M pre-Series A led by Paspalis with BHP Ventures and IQT (Sep 2025). Total is approximate because of SGD conversion; no Series A yet.

companies.name: Alcemy
companies.description: Revolutionizing cement and concrete production.
companies.funding_notes: alcemy.tech (Berlin ML software for low-carbon cement/concrete). Disclosed equity ~€19.3M: €10M Series A led by Galvanize Climate Solutions (Sep 2022) plus ~US$10M (~€9.3M) extension led by Norrsken VC (Jul 2024); total excludes the undisclosed 2019 seed from La Famiglia, firstminute and LocalGlobe (seed amount only in databases, not verified). Mixed-currency total is approximate.

companies.name: Faircraft
companies.description: Developing a highly sustainable, lab-grown alternative to animal leather.
companies.funding_notes: faircraft.bio (Paris lab-grown leather). ~€19.4M raised: €4.4M seed (Jun 2022; Les Echos reported $4.6M incl. ~$1M debt) and €15M Series A backed by Kindred Ventures and Bpifrance (Nov 2024; reported as $15.8M, Luxury Tribune says €15.2M). In May 2025 Faircraft acquired VitroLabs' assets/patents (it was the acquirer, not acquired).

companies.name: Flexciton
companies.description: AI planning and scheduling for autonomous factories.

grants.name: Innovate UK investment in Flexciton–Seagate production planning project

companies.funding_notes: flexciton.com (London AI scheduling for semiconductor fabs). Sourced equity £17.5M: £2.5M seed led by Backed VC (Jan 2019) and £15M Series A led by Nadav Rosenberg/Saras Capital (Oct 2021). Company says it has received 'over £21m in funding' in total, implying an additional ~£3M+ (databases list a ~£3M Jan 2020 round, not confirmed by an allowed source) and/or grants.

companies.name: La Vie
companies.description: Plant-based bacon and ham substitutes.
companies.funding_notes: laviefoods.com (Paris plant-based bacon/lardons). €50M raised per company: €25M Series A led by Seventure (Jan 2022) and €25M in Oct 2024 from existing shareholders, Zintinus, Sparkfood and France's largest equity-crowdfunding campaign (stage not named). No pre-Series A rounds publicly disclosed.

companies.name: Merkle Science
companies.description: Blockchain analytics for compliance and risk.
companies.funding_notes: merklescience.com (crypto risk/blockchain analytics, Singapore/New York). ~US$24.8M raised: ~US$0.8M seed (May 2019) plus a Series A totalling 'over $24M' (US$5.75M led by Darrow Holdings in Sep 2021, US$19M+ extension co-led by BECO, Darrow and K3 in Aug 2022). Total approximate since extension stated as 'more than $19M'; Merkle acquired Staging Labs in Jun 2024 (acquirer).

companies.name: Kular
companies.description: AI lead generation for small teams.
companies.funding_notes: kular.ai (London AI lead generation; YC W22). Publicly backed only by accelerators (Y Combinator, Entrepreneur First), Acequia Capital and unnamed angels per its YC profile; no round amounts disclosed by an allowed source (a ~$500K 2022 'seed' appears only in databases and matches YC's standard deal). No priced seed or later round found. Caveat: kular.ai currently shows an expired Squarespace site (checked 2026-10-11), so the company may be inactive.

companies.name: Magdrive
companies.description: Electromagnetic thrusters for small satellites.

grants.name: Non-dilutive grants from UK Space Agency, European Space Agency and other government agencies (aggregate)

companies.funding_notes: magdrive.space (UK electric plasma thrusters for small satellites). ~US$12.3M equity: 2020 round led by Founders Fund (TechCrunch: US$1.8M/£1.4M 'seed'; SpaceNews: US$2M 'pre-seed') and a US$10.5M seed led by Redalpine (Feb 2025); plus 'more than $10M' in UKSA/ESA and other government grants. Round label and amount for 2020 conflict between sources.

companies.name: Scope
companies.description: AI inspection for supply chains.
companies.funding_notes: getscope.ai (London AI workflow platform for industrial testing/inspection/certification, founded 2024 by Jonathan Low and Jakob Cassiman at EF). ~US$24M raised: Susa-led pre-seed and seed (seed reported as US$4M in Aug 2024 by Nordic9 only) and a US$20M (£15M) Series A led by Index Ventures (May 2026). Input says 'supply chains' but site/press describe industrial asset inspection; seed amount from an aggregator, pre-seed amount undisclosed.

companies.name: zeroheight
companies.description: DesignOps workspace for cross-functional teams.
companies.funding_notes: zeroheight.com (London design-system documentation/DesignOps; YC S19). Sourced equity US$10M: Series A led by Tribe Capital with Adobe, YC, FundersClub and Expa (Aug 2021). Earlier 2019 YC/pre-seed/seed money (~$0.9M in databases) not confirmed by an allowed source, so excluded from total.

companies.name: Chattermill
companies.description: AI sentiment analysis for customer feedback.
companies.funding_notes: chattermill.com (London AI customer-feedback analytics). ~US$35.2M raised: £600K seed (Dec 2017; total then £935K incl. earlier EF money), US$8M Series A led by DN Capital (Feb 2020) and US$26M Series B led by Beringea (Dec 2022). Total approximate (GBP converted).

companies.name: Better Dairy
companies.description: Fermented milk proteins without animals.
companies.funding_notes: betterdairy.com (London precision-fermentation dairy proteins; now focused on osteopontin/lactopontin plus casein). ~US$24.2M raised: £1.6M seed led by Happiness Capital (2020) and US$22M Series A co-led by Redalpine and Vorwerk Ventures (Feb 2022). A 2025 deal appears only in databases (not confirmed by allowed sources).

companies.name: Metomic
companies.description: Data security for SaaS applications.
companies.funding_notes: metomic.io (London SaaS data security/DLP). ~US$21.8M raised: ~£1.4M (~US$1.8M) seed from Connect Ventures (May 2019, reported by Nordic9 aggregator only) and US$20M Series A led by Evolution Equity Partners (Feb 2023). Seed amount less well sourced; no later round found.

companies.name: Converge
companies.description: Wireless concrete monitoring for builders.

grants.name: UKRI Transforming Construction (Innovate UK) grant, CORE project with BAM Nuttall (project no. 104800; project total, Converge share not stated)

companies.funding_notes: converge.io (London AI + wireless concrete sensors, ConcreteDNA). ~US$46M raised: £3.9M venture round after its UKRI grant (~2019-20, stage/investors not stated), 'over £15M' Series A led by OGCI Climate Investments (May 2022) and US$22M led by ABN AMRO Sustainable Impact Fund (May 2025, stage not named). Total approximate (GBP converted, Series A a floor); early EF/Martlet seed amount undisclosed.

companies.name: Tuza
companies.description: Instant card-machine quotes for businesses.
